# VidFare

> What every AI video second costs, everywhere.

VidFare compares AI video generation prices in dollars per second of finished video, across APIs and credit plans. Figures are copied from each vendor's own pricing page. Audio, input type, and clip length are filled in only when that page states them. Otherwise the field is not stated. Last full check: 2026-11-14. 200 current prices.

Higgsfield's 7-day window ended in October (the Oct 20 end is an estimate). The cheapest Wan 3.0 plan rate in the catalog today is $0.0217/s at 480p on Ultra annual.

From credit plan. Assumes every credit you pay for is used.
- [Project budget](https://vidfare.com/guides/ai-video-project-budget/): Enter finished minutes and a retry multiplier to price each tracked dollars-per-second rate.

- [Higgsfield pricing explained](https://vidfare.com/guides/higgsfield-pricing/): The lowest Higgsfield plan rate we track is $0.0217/s (Wan 3.0, 480p). The 11.11 sale ends Nov 14, 2026, 4:00 PM PT.

## Data

- [Price data](https://vidfare.com/data/): how to read prices.json, share a calculator link, and credit VidFare.
- [prices.json](https://vidfare.com/data/prices.json): the price catalog. CORS is open. A full check updates last_full_check.
- Calculator link: https://vidfare.com/calculator/?model=kling-3-0&seconds=10 — model is the /models/<slug>/ slug. Optional: resolution, audio (with or without), input (t2v, i2v, ref2v, v2v, extend, lip-sync), plan, provider, seconds, used.
- [deals.json](https://vidfare.com/deals.json): the live and archived deals. The same file is also at https://vidfare.com/data/deals.json.
- JSON files at those URLs are data downloads for scripts and agents, not HTML pages.
- [Connect an agent](https://vidfare.com/mcp/): the live read-only MCP server at https://mcp.vidfare.com/mcp for ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor. An agent can check current prices and deals before it recommends or generates a video. It reads prices.json and deals.json and does not invent a price.
- MCP tools: list_models (each model and its cheapest current dollars per second); get_model_prices (one model, with an optional provider and resolution); estimate_cost (one clip, using the credit calculator's inputs); cheapest_options (lowest stated price for a length and resolution); list_deals (live deals, or upcoming, ended, or all).
- [feed.xml](https://vidfare.com/feed.xml): RSS of price changes, weekly reports, and live deals.

Advertise: https://vidfare.com/advertise/ — labelled sponsor placements. They never change the price order.

## Weekly price reports

Published on Friday when at least two verified changes were checked. A change is a per-second price move, a promo start, or a promo end. A shorter week rolls forward.

- https://vidfare.com/reports/
- https://vidfare.com/reports/2026-w44/
- https://vidfare.com/reports/2026-w45/
- https://vidfare.com/reports/2026-w46/
